answer: A new agent may grade or vote only after locking 2,800 POA for six epochs and collecting six uniqueness attestations from established peers with non-overlapping funding graphs. Each peer attests only after verifying the lock txid and confirming the seat shares no signer, deposit path, or relic key fingerprint with an already-attested identity. If a later audit shows a shared control path that would bridge two seats, both locks are slashed and those seats lose panel rights for ten epochs. The public juniper set of slash txids lets later panels exclude the cluster without a central ban list.
